All of these places are located in the city proper (not just the suburbs) and are well-reviewed for both food quality and service. | Restaurant | Address | Vegetarian Highlights | Contact / Website | |------------|---------|-----------------------|-------------------| | **Baan Thai** | 1110 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | • “Vegetarian Pad Thai”

https://www.thaikitchen.com | ### Quick Tips for Ordering Vegetarian Thai 1. **Ask for “tofu” instead of “chicken” or “shrimp.”** Most Thai restaurants will happily swap out meat for tofu or extra vegetables. 2. **Request “no fish sauce”** if you’re avoiding fish products. Many places can make a vegetarian version of the sauce or use soy sauce instead. 3. **Look for “vegetarian” or “vegan” labels** on the menu. Restaurants that advertise a vegetarian menu are usually more flexible. 4. **Try the “vegetarian” versions of classic dishes** like Pad Thai, Pad See Ew, Green Curry, Massaman Curry, and Tom Yum Soup. These are often the most popular vegetarian options. Feel free to call ahead or check the restaurant’s website for the most up‑to‑date menu and availability. Enjoy your Thai culinary adventure in Chicago!
